items.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.title_cn: 训练编译：将自然语言规范转化为局部神经功能
items.summary: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable n...
items.summary_cn: 许多循环文本函数易于描述，但难以使用规则实现，而为每个输入调用大型远程模型会引入重复的成本、延迟和对提供程序的依赖。我们介绍通过训练编译，它将自然语言规范转化为可重用的...
items.comment: 新模型发布，效果先观望，按 token 计费的玩法，用得起吗？

items.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints
items.title_cn: 清洁工程，不稳定测量：共享端点上黑盒LLM观察员的预注册可靠性故障
items.summary: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to the same model name, reads the same tomorrow. We audited that assumption in two preregistered campai...
items.summary_cn: 语言模型评委现在可以选择训练数据、分数生成和驱动排行榜。然后，法官是一个测量工具，基于一个很少陈述的假设：相同的请求，发送到相同的型号名称，明天读取相同的。我们在两个预先注册的CAMPAI中审核了这一假设...
items.comment: 模型发布热闹非凡，能不能用、好不好用，用户说了算。

items.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
items.title_cn: ESPO ：通过诊断、多样化和稳定的错误结构化提示优化
items.summary: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. We trace this to three deficiencies - incomplete error observation, limited search diversity, and unreliable selection - and ...
items.summary_cn: 进化提示优化器（如GEPA ）会出现提示臃肿：每次迭代都会附加规则和警告，产生的提示最多会延长3 $\ times $ ，但不会更准确。我们将其归因于三个缺陷-不完整的错误观察，有限的搜索多样性和不可靠的选择-以及...
items.comment: 开源是好事，能不能用起来、改起来，才是衡量价值的标准。

items.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
